policy.rule: A release gate cannot PASS if it depends on an OPEN or REJECTED requirement.
policy.source_rule: A requirement may come from a controlled document, calculation, regulation, test, or explicit design-authority directive. Missing source is a release hold.

requirements.title: Hermetic calibration actuation
requirements.statement: Provide controlled linear calibration motion without a moving shaft penetration through the containment boundary.

requirements.title: J2 service access
requirements.statement: P003↔P007 shall remain removable so P006/follower service does not require destruction of the containment can.

requirements.title: Calibration stroke
requirements.statement: Functional rod stroke shall be 10.0 mm.
requirements.verification_method: CAD mate/envelope verification + bench stroke measurement

requirements.title: Feedthrough envelope
requirements.statement: The chamber-side feedthrough interface shall fit within a nominal Ø10 mm input envelope unless a controlled interface change is approved.

requirements.title: P007 overall length
requirements.statement: P007 overall length shall remain 35.0 mm for the C2R1 mechanical baseline.

requirements.title: J2 locating architecture
requirements.statement: J2 transverse location shall be controlled by the Ø14.10 H7/g6 pilot/locator pair and axial location by the metal mating faces; clamp screws shall not be redundant datum controls.

requirements.title: P003 material
requirements.statement: P003 production material shall be AISI 316L / EN 1.4404.

requirements.title: P007 material
requirements.statement: P007 production material shall be AISI 316L / EN 1.4404.

requirements.title: P006 production material
requirements.statement: P006 production material shall be defined and released before product release.

source.ref: No controlled source currently confirms P006 production material

requirements.title: J2 differential-pressure envelope
requirements.statement: Maximum positive and negative differential pressure acting across the J2/P007 containment boundary shall be explicitly released.

source.ref: ±0.20 bar exists as an analysis case, not yet as a released product requirement

requirements.title: J2 local temperature envelope
requirements.statement: Minimum/nominal/maximum J2 metal and elastomer temperatures shall be bounded for the released application.

source.ref: System documentation does not prove the local J2 seal temperature

requirements.title: J2 media/cleaning envelope
requirements.statement: Process gas, condensate and cleaning-media species that may contact J2 shall be bounded for elastomer qualification.

source.ref: MARV 2EX process/containment documents; exact J2 exposure still open

requirements.verification_method: media specification + supplier compatibility statement + leak qualification

requirements.title: J2 static seal
requirements.statement: J2 shall use a static face seal architecture sized for the released media, temperature, pressure and service envelope.

source.ref: 16×1.5 gland architecture controlled; exact compound open

requirements.verification_method: gland tolerance stack + compression-force qualification + leak test

requirements.title: Leak acceptance
requirements.statement: A quantitative J2 leak-test acceptance criterion shall be defined before production release.

source.ref: No released numerical leak criterion currently recorded

requirements.title: Repeated service life
requirements.statement: Required number of J2/P006 service cycles shall be released; provisional 50-cycle screening is not itself a product requirement.

requirements.title: Actuator force coefficient
requirements.statement: Final electromagnetic design shall meet or exceed the released minimum force/force-coefficient envelope over stroke, current, temperature and production tolerances.

source.ref: Current screening target KFmin ≥ 0.930895 N/A at nominal 1 A; final load inputs still subject to release

requirements.title: Production technical definition
requirements.statement: Released manufacturing definition shall unambiguously communicate functionally necessary size, fit, GD&T, material, finish, process and inspection characteristics without contradictory dimensions.
requirements.verification_method: drawing semantic QA + visual QA + inspection-plan cross-check
